summary: Phase 9 member portal (wish reminders, photo captions, album slideshow, gathering recaps) — backend 19/19 PASS + regression Phase 7 (35) + Phase 8 (22) = 57/57 PASS; frontend testids and interactions verified end-to-end. New file /app/backend/tests/test_members_phase9.py covers: (1) PUT /api/members/gathering-photos/{pid}/caption — uploader can edit while status=pending, 403 for other members, 403 after approval, admin can edit any time (even approved), caption truncated to 200 chars; upload POST accepts form caption field and persists. (2) ZIP GET /api/members/albums/{mid}/download contains captions.txt with full caption lines and caption-slug based filenames when captions exist. (3) GET /api/members/albums-slideshow returns only approved photos (pending excluded), each row has gathering_title; auth required. (4) _send_wish_reminders(day, 'eve'/'day') with send_email monkeypatched: celebrant excluded from own reminders, members with bday_notices=False excluded, members who already posted a wish reply this year excluded; idempotent per (kind, celebrant, day) via scheduled_runs 'wishrem:...' marker — second call returns 0 recipients. (5) Recaps: GET /api/admin/members/recaps lists past in-person gatherings with approved photos (admin-gated), POST /api/admin/members/recaps/{mid}/preview returns html containing /api/recap-photo/<pid>?t=<token> URLs and the note, GET /api/recap-photo/<pid>?t=<correct_token> returns 200 image/png without auth, wrong token => 404, >6 photo_ids rejected 400, _send_recap(mid, ids, note, by) direct call sends 1 email per active member (2 active QA members => 2 emails, both carry tokenized photo URL), sets recap_sent_at/recap_by/recap_count/recap_photo_ids, second call returns -1 (idempotent), HTTP /send on same gathering 400 'already sent', /send 404 for unknown gathering, /send member-gated. (6) _auto_recaps(today): sends recaps for gatherings 3-10 days old with approved photos and no recap_sent_at, out-of-window (1 day ago) is skipped, run twice does NOT change recap_sent_at (idempotent). Scheduler hook _member_phase7_scheduled now triggers eve+day wish reminders at hour>=18 and _auto_recaps at hour>=10. Frontend (Playwright, viewport 1920x4000): Member A /members Photos tab -> albums-grid shows albums-slideshow-all button, QA album tile opens album-view with album-caption-input, album-slideshow-btn, album-download-zip, and 2 album-caption-<pid> overlays rendered under thumbnails; opening a non-owned approved photo shows album-lightbox-caption (read-only) and NO album-caption-edit (correct — not uploader + approved). Album slideshow: slideshow renders with slideshow-index='1' + slideshow-caption='Welcome moment', ArrowRight advances to '2', slideshow-next-zone tap advances to '1' (wraps), slideshow-prev/next/toggle/close + prev-zone/next-zone + space key toggle all functional, Escape closes slideshow. Play all albums (albums-slideshow-all) also opens the slideshow. Admin /admin -> Members tab -> members-sub-photos sub: admin-recaps card renders with recap-row-qa-ph9-ui-recap, recap-open-qa-ph9-ui-recap toggles RecapEditor, 2 recap-photo-<pid> toggles pre-selected (max 6), recap-note textarea, recap-preview button opens recap-preview-frame-<mid> iframe populated with server HTML, recap-send button present. All QA data (qa_mem_a/b members, qa_tok_123 admin session, qa-ph9-* meetings, member_profile customizations, birthday threads, wishrem:* scheduled_runs markers) cleaned via qa_members.py down + qa_session.py down + explicit mongo deletes.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~9294 lines. Phase 9 added ~155 lines inline (captions, slideshow, wish reminders, recap HTML + endpoints + auto job). The entire member-portal block (Phases 2-9, ~2500 lines) should be split into backend/members/*.py routers — reiterated from iterations 27/28/29.

_send_recap marks recap_sent_at BEFORE the per-recipient send loop. If send_email raises partway through the active-member fan-out, recap_count will reflect only successful sends but the gathering is permanently flagged 'sent' — remaining sisters will never get the recap and the admin cannot retry (second call returns -1, HTTP /send 400). Consider marking recap_sent_at only after the loop and persisting a 'in-flight' lock, or exposing an admin 'retry recap' endpoint.

GET /api/recap-photo/{pid} compares tokens via secrets.compare_digest but is not rate-limited; because tokens are 18-byte urlsafe (~24 chars) brute-force is infeasible, yet adding a per-IP rate_limit of e.g. 60/min would mitigate scanning for valid pids. Low priority.

_recap_html builds an HTML string with chr(10)->'
' replacement AFTER _esc(). _esc preserves newlines so this works, but a long note with 2000 chars could produce a very large
wall; consider wrapping in

blocks on blank lines for readability.

_auto_recaps iterates up to 20 past gatherings and awaits _send_recap sequentially within the scheduled task; for a 200+ member club with multiple eligible gatherings this blocks the loop for N*members SMTP calls. Consider BackgroundTasks or a queue — same O(N) email concern raised about _send_birthday_emails in iteration_28.
members_album_download currently loads up to 300 approved blobs into memory to build the ZIP (StreamingResponse recommendation from iteration_29 still open).

RecapIn.photo_ids has no min/max constraint at the Pydantic level — >6 is enforced manually in handlers. Use `conlist(str, max_length=6)` so FastAPI auto-generates the 422 and OpenAPI reflects the limit.

MyWishes.jsx (/app/frontend/src/components/members/Phase7.jsx:197-209) computes 'this month' via `new Date().getMonth()+1` in browser time while server uses _today_et() — same timezone-edge comment from iteration_29 still open.

Slideshow.jsx attempts requestFullscreen on mount; many preview iframes block fullscreen causing a silent catch, which is fine for QA but can confuse non-iframe users. Consider only entering fullscreen on first user gesture (e.g., the slideshow-fullscreen button) to avoid the Chrome 'Fullscreen must come from user activation' console warning seen on first mount in some browsers.

Prereq same as phases 7/8: python3 /app/backend/tests/qa_session.py up && python3 /app/backend/tests/qa_members.py up && update users.member_status='active' + member_since for qa_mem_a/b. The module uses the same _rebind_motor + shared _LOOP pattern as phases 7/8 for direct function calls into server.py (_send_wish_reminders, _send_recap, _auto_recaps). The lightbox in Phase7.jsx closes on backdrop click or close button but NOT on Escape, which can trip tests that reuse Escape — close lightbox before opening slideshow.
rca of the issue: N/A — no functional issues found in Phase 9 backend or frontend. The one transient Playwright click failure was test-script sequencing (lightbox still open was intercepting pointer events on album-slideshow-btn); resolved by not opening the lightbox before the slideshow click. All assertions passed on re-run.
